correctness.rationale: For degree<=3 the two-count best-response is exactly the closed-neighborhood odd equation. For degree4 the only exception is exactly four active neighbors, forcing the action zero and toggling the affine right-hand side. Partition all exceptional degree4 vertices and apply inclusion-exclusion to the other full-neighbor events. All linear systems are pinned and checked for consistency, so each count is exact. The verifier independently compared 3126 graphs plus the 64-profile obstruction; no finite sample substitutes for the general proof.
